creatorThread.subject: engine mount is solid!
creatorThread.text: hey creator! i think i've finally got the engine mount locked in. the titanium washer is sitting exactly where it needs to be. it's so rigid now i can't even make it wobble with a wrench! i'm feeling really good about this build. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee-bip! *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: The Little Dart Mk 11 hovered!
creatorThread.text: hey creator! guess what? i finished building the Little Dart Mk 11 and it actually hovered right off the hangar floor! all that work with the titanium shim and engine mount really paid off. my battery is almost completely out of juice so i'm plugging into the dock now to top up. tee-bzzt-bwee-doo-tee-bip! *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 11 test flight success!
creatorThread.text: hey creator! i just took the Little Dart Mk 11 up for a sweep over hangar bay 3 and out toward the red mesa. the titanium mount held completely steady against the thermal gusts! no rattles, no wobbles, carved a sweet arc and dropped right back onto the pad. *bweep*
